title: Chemical Cleaning PPE & Acid Storage: Rules & Obligations (Have to, Must not)
description: Foundational food process engineering English module covering chemical cleaning ppe & acid storage: rules & obligations (have to, must not).
learning_objectives: Master professional Rules & Obligations (have to, must not) in food process engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in chemical cleaning ppe & acid storage: rules & obligations (have to, must not)
Demonstrate precision in refrigeration maintenance logs, CIP cycles, and plant automation SOPs

questions.prompt: Before starting the shift, the plant process engineer _____ maintain suction pressure at 0.5 bar for spiral freezers.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed by the bare infinitive without 'to': 'must maintain'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'is must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: V angličtině se po způsobovém slovesu 'must' nikdy nepoužívá předložka 'to' (*must to* je hrubá chyba).

questions.prompt: Every morning, the industrial refrigeration technician safely _____ the continuous cryogenic blast freezing tunnel along the automated food processing conveyor.

explanations.correct: Singular subject takes 3rd person singular Present Simple with '-s' ('defrosts').
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'defrost' lacks required 3rd person singular '-s'.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'defrosting' cannot act as finite verb without auxiliary.

questions.cz_learning_point: Ve 3. osobě jednotného čísla přítomného času prostého nezapomeňte na koncovku -s: 'defrosts'.

questions.prompt: The technician placed the diagnostic tool _____ the workbench at the CIP sanitation chemical dosing station.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'on' correctly denotes physical placement on a horizontal surface.
explanations.wrong_B: 'into' denotes motion entering inside an enclosed space.
explanations.wrong_C: 'under to' is an invalid double preposition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'between of' is ungrammatical; 'between' does not take 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Čeština používá 'na stole' = 'on the workbench'. Dejte pozor na chybná spojení jako *between of*.

questions.prompt: Yesterday during the handover, the food processing line operator _____ the sanitary stainless steel pasteurizer flow diversion valve.

explanations.correct: Specific past time adverbial 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'tested'.
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'divert' lacks past tense inflection.
explanations.wrong_B: Present perfect 'has tested' cannot accompany finished past time 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's finished events.

questions.cz_learning_point: S příslovečným určením jako 'yesterday' se v angličtině striktně pojí minulý čas prostý (Past Simple), nikdy předpřítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Are there _____ spare gaskets left in the workshop storage cabinet?

explanations.correct: 'Any' is standard in questions inquiring about the existence or availability of items.
explanations.wrong_A: 'some' is typically reserved for affirmative statements or polite offers.
explanations.wrong_B: 'much' is only used with uncountable mass nouns, not plural 'gaskets'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'an' can only precede singular countable nouns beginning with a vowel sound.

questions.cz_learning_point: V běžných záporných větách a otázkách se pro 'nějaký / žádný' používá 'any', nikoli *some*.

questions.prompt: _____ the maintenance technician inspect the industrial steam boiler feedwater deaerator every shift?

explanations.correct: Singular 3rd person subject in Present Simple requires auxiliary 'Does'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'Do' is used for plural subjects (they, we, you) or 'I'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Is' requires an '-ing' participle (Present Continuous), not a base verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: V otázkách v přítomném čase se pro 3. osobu jednotného čísla používá pomocné sloveso 'Does': 'Does the technician inspect...?'.

questions.prompt: The newly calibrated unit runs significantly _____ than the older model.

explanations.wrong_A: 'more fast' is ungrammatical; short adjectives take '-er'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Jednoslabičná přídavná jména tvoří 2. stupeň koncovkou -er (faster, cheaper), nikoli pomocí *more*.

questions.prompt: _____ new components on this table must be cataloged immediately.

explanations.correct: Plural noun 'components' located nearby requires plural demonstrative 'These'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'This' is singular and cannot modify plural 'components'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'There' is an adverb of place or dummy pronoun, not a demonstrative determiner.

questions.cz_learning_point: Množné číslo pro věci blízko mluvčího je 'these' (tyto součástky), jednotné číslo je 'this' (tato součástka).

questions.prompt: The team transferred the heavy assembly _____ the testing bay.

explanations.correct: 'Into' expresses movement from the outside to the interior of a space.
explanations.wrong_A: 'in to' as two separate words is incorrect for directional movement.

questions.cz_learning_point: Směr dovnitř vyjadřuje předložka 'into' (přesunout do testovací haly = transferred into the bay).

questions.prompt: Could you please _____ the shift report before leaving today?

explanations.correct: Polite request with modal 'Could you please' is followed by the bare infinitive 'sign'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'to sign' is incorrect; modals do not take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'signed' is ungrammatical after modal 'could'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po zdvořilostní žádosti 'Could you please' následuje vždy základní tvar slovesa (bare infinitive) bez 'to'.
